title: 조기진급 등에 관한 규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:24148:20121029:00001:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 24148, October 29, 2012>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on January 1, 2013.

Article 2 (Amendments to Other Statutes or Regulations)
(1) The Enforcement Decree of the Gifted Education Promotion Act shall be partially amended as follows:

In the former part of Article 24 (2), "notwithstanding the Regulations on Early Promotion and Early Graduation, the school regulations" shall be replaced with "notwithstanding the Regulations on Early Promotion, etc., the school regulations shall".

(2) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on Educational Support for Overseas Koreans, etc. shall be partially amended as follows:

Article 3 (1) 5 shall be replaced with the following:
5. Granting qualifications for early promotion, early graduation and early admission to schools of higher level.

(3) The Enforcement Decree of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act shall be partially amended as follows:

Article 9 (1) 5 shall be replaced with the following:
5. Granting qualifications for early promotion, early graduation and early admission to schools of higher level.

In Article 29 (2), "Committee for Evaluation of Completion of Individual Subjects under Article 6 of the Regulations on Early Promotion and Early Graduation" shall be replaced with "Committee for Evaluation of Early Promotion, Graduation and Admission under Article 5 of the Regulations on Early Promotion, etc."

In Article 98-4, "Committee for Evaluation of Completion of Individual Subjects under Article 6 of the Regulations on Early Promotion and Early Graduation" shall be replaced with "Committee for Evaluation of Early Promotion, Graduation and Admission under Article 5 of the Regulations on Early Promotion, etc."

Article 3 (Relationship to Other Statutes or Regulations)
Where another statute or regulation refers to the former Regulations on Early Promotion and Early Graduation or a provision thereof as at the time this Decree enters into force, and this Decree contains a corresponding provision, that reference shall be deemed to refer to this Decree or its corresponding provision instead of the former Regulations or provision.
